parsed.summary: Here’s a practical checklist of what you and Mei should gather and do before submitting your first BTO application as an engaged Singapore‑Citizen couple.

claims.text: Both applicants must be Singapore Citizens to apply for a BTO flat.
First‑timer couples must not have previously owned or sold any HDB flat or received any HDB subsidy.
You need a valid HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter before the ballot opens; the letter is issued after you submit the eligibility check on the HDB portal.
Create an account on the HDB Resale & BTO portal (https://services2.hdb.gov.sg) and complete the online eligibility check to obtain your HFE letter.

Gather the following documents for each applicant: NRIC (original and clear photocopy), latest income tax notice of assessment (if applicable), and recent payslips or employment letters (to confirm employment as a nurse and teacher).

If either of you has any private property interest (e.g., a landed property or private condo), obtain the relevant ownership documents; first‑timer couples must not own any private residential property at the time of application.
Prepare a digital copy of your marriage or civil partnership certificate (or a statutory declaration of engagement) – HDB may request proof of your relationship status during the application.

Check your combined monthly household income against the current income ceiling for the BTO project you intend to apply for (usually S$14,000 for 4‑room flats); you can find the latest ceiling on the HDB website.
Decide which flat type and location you prefer, and note the ballot dates for those projects; mark the dates on your calendar so you can submit the ballot as soon as it opens.
Set up a bank account that can be used for HDB loan or CPF housing grant applications, as you will need to link it during the post‑ballot processing stage.
Specific document requirements and income ceilings may vary by project and are updated periodically; please verify the latest details on hdb.gov.sg or the HDB Flat Portal before you submit.
